name: io.github.GauravBR/inkrelay
title: InkRelay
description: Print PDFs, ZPL labels and ESC/POS receipts on your printers and follow print jobs via InkRelay

environmentVariables.name: INKRELAY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: InkRelay API key from app.inkrelay.app/api-keys. ir_test_ keys print only to free virtual printers.

environmentVariables.name: INKRELAY_FILE_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Folder that filePath arguments must stay inside. Defaults to the working directory.
